dedupe_keys.name: central bureau of statistics dpr korea 2008 population census national report with household tables on dwelling type floor area rooms water supply toilet facility heating system and cooking fuel by province and urban and rural area

description: The Central Bureau of Statistics of the DPR Korea published the national report of its 2008 Population Census, the country's second census, and the UN Statistics Division hosts the 277 page English PDF. Besides population tables it has a housing section with households by occupancy status, floor area and rooms, source of water supply, type of toilet facility, type of heating system and cooking fuel, each by province and by urban and rural area. The heating table is cross classified by dwelling type; of 5,887,471 households, 263,809 used a central or local heating system and 2,773,238 a coal boiler or briquette hole in the dwelling. Coverage is national, in one of the few official statistical sources on housing services in the country. Format and access: free PDF, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: data are from 2008, tables stop at province level, and tables span several PDF pages that need careful extraction; no national statistics website was identified. Simulation uses: province shares of district and electric heating against coal and wood for energy demand and air quality studies, and water supply sources for service planning. Related records: none in the catalogue for this country.
